design.pairing: each GPU session holds ONE output size and both arms (base + candidate) back to back in the same session; the arm order alternates between sessions (rotating) so each arm runs first in half of the sessions

refill.mechanism: decode only: the slots lent to the layer-major hidden store are restored to their pre-prefill experts behind the last layer, so early decode tokens miss less; effect grows with the borrowed slot count (largest at 120K)

gain_definition: per round and cell: lower_is_better metrics g = base/candidate - 1; higher_is_better metrics g = candidate/base - 1 (positive = candidate better)

decision_rule.cell_pass: median(g over the 3 rounds) >= +0.02 AND every round g > 0
keep_if_all: teacher QUALIFY_PASS for the candidate (teacher max_abs 0.0, forced targets complete, no new functional failures)
content_sha256 identical between base and candidate for every paired request
VRAM gate PASS (min free >= 0.5 GiB floor) in every candidate run
no HARM cell for any guard metric at any length/output
decision_rule.otherwise: REJECT (feature stays out of the next update; code may stay flag-off). Missing rounds or a failed session = INCONCLUSIVE, handled as REJECT for this update.
decision_rule.teacher_first: the teacher runs before the A/B; a teacher failure rejects the feature and skips its A/B
